verdict.rationale: Working Copy keeps your data as standard Git repositories. You can push them over https, ssh, git or http to any host, including self-hosted Linux, BSD or NAS servers. All repositories are also exposed through the Files app and to third-party apps, and a built-in WebDAV server moves files in and out, so the core content can leave in open formats. A user who pulls and pushes a GitHub-hosted book corroborates that work lives in standard remotes. Missing for 10: documented export of app-level data such as identities, private SSH keys and settings; any explicit 'export everything' feature; independent hands-on reports of fully migrating away.
